turns.question: Which channel brought us the most bookings in September 2026, and how many?
turns.answer: Search brought the most bookings in September 2026, with 31 bookings for 1 to 30 September 2026 (Social had 20 and Email had 3). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
